claims.claim: 大模型有几十亿到上千亿个参数（旋钮），训练每一步都要算每个参数的梯度
claims.source: Brown et al. 2020（GPT-3，1750 亿参数，第一季 t10 已核）；PyTorch 教程：每个参数的梯度存进 .grad
claims.quote: Autograd then calculates and stores the gradients for each model parameter in the parameter's .grad attribute.

claims.claim: 挨个旋钮试拧（有限差分）每个旋钮要多算一遍：N 个旋钮共 N+1 遍正着算
齿轮比方：×2、×3 一路乘起来 6；倒着算每步多乘一次（链式法则的直觉）
claims.check: scenes/data.py：gears 断言；Rumelhart 1986 原文 'We can then apply the chain rule'

claims.claim: 两层小网络七个旋钮；5 公里那趟实付 23 元（示意数据）；A=6、B=4、猜 29、多猜 6
倒着走一趟：第二层 36、24、6；传回 A 12、B 6；第一层 60、12、30、6；都为正、都往小拧
按七个数各拧一小步（步子 0.005），猜 29 → 23.88
挨个试拧算出的七个坡度与反向传播一致；反向传播只要正着一遍、倒着一趟
十亿个旋钮挨个试要 1,000,000,001 遍；假设一遍一秒约 31.7 年；所以靠挨个试，几十亿个旋钮的大模型实际训练不动（反向传播约 3 遍工夫，见 C09）
claims.check: scenes/data.py：years 断言（假设一遍一秒）

claims.claim: 倒着一趟约是正着一遍的两倍工夫，合计约三遍
claims.source: scenes/data.py 乘法计数（2.89）；Kaplan et al. 2020, Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models §2.1（arXiv:2001.08361，ar5iv 全文核对）
claims.quote: Accounting for the backwards pass (approximately twice the compute as the forwards pass), we then define the estimated non-embedding compute as C ≈ 6N floating point operators per training token.

claims.claim: 1986 年 Rumelhart、Hinton、Williams 在《自然》发表反向传播论文
claims.quote: We describe a new learning procedure, back-propagation, for networks of neurone-like units.

claims.claim: 论文里每个权重的偏导分两趟算：正着一趟，再从最上一层倒着传回
claims.quote: For a given case, the partial derivatives of the error with respect to each weight are computed in two passes. … The backward pass which propagates derivatives from the top layer back to the bottom one

claims.claim: 这样训练，隐藏单元会表示任务里的重要特征
claims.quote: internal 'hidden' units which are not part of the input or output come to represent important features of the task domain

claims.claim: 类似算法在 1986 年之前已有人提出：Linnainmaa 1970 发表反向模式自动微分，Werbos 1982 把它用于多层网络；不说 1986 论文发明或最早提出
screen: 类似的算法，更早已有人提出
claims.source: Wikipedia: Backpropagation — History · Modern backpropagation（2026-11-09 取原始 wikitext 核对）
claims.quote: Modern backpropagation was first published by Seppo Linnainmaa as "reverse mode of automatic differentiation" (1970) … In 1982, Paul Werbos applied backpropagation to MLPs in the way that has become standard.

claims.claim: PyTorch 里调用 .backward()，自动求导从输出倒着走，算出每个参数的梯度
claims.source: PyTorch 教程 A Gentle Introduction to torch.autograd
claims.quote: It does this by traversing backwards from the output, collecting the derivatives of the error with respect to the parameters of the functions (gradients)
